notes: Logged values from the training process on the A100 (BF16 autocast; eval cross-entropy fp32, fp64 sums).

The log covers the tranche (updates 1-2,000) and the continuation (2,001-52,034) of the same run. Updates re-executed after a restore appear more than once in the raw log; this extract keeps the last record per update (85 replayed records dropped; the independent audit verified identical batch fingerprints for the replayed updates 8,501-8,585).

eval_bpb is bits per UTF-8 byte over the full j1-base-v0.2.2 validation split (2,576 documents, 12,311,466 scored bytes, 3,218,204 targets); it was observed during training as a monitoring set and is not an unbiased test estimate.
train loss is the per-update mean cross-entropy (nats) over 65,536 targets.
